sources.title: Gautam6/GautamAI · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview Gautam AI is a State-of-the-Art (SOTA) Supreme Autonomous AGI Model developed by Gautam AI Ecosystem. It completely supersedes and removes legacy third-party base architectures (such as Qwen or others), operating with an autonomous continuous self-improving curriculum loop, 4-bit sparse quantization, and multi-domain reasoning capabilities.

sources.title: Gautam AI
sources.snippet: Gautam AI builds custom machine learning models that transform raw data into actionable intelligence. Our models are optimized for accuracy, scalability, interpretability, and production deployment.
